soft_issues: Several 2017 biomass-share figures are images, so exact percentages beyond the stated ranges are not readable in the extract.

claim_checks.claim: The report is part of FHF project Havbruksforvaltning 2030 (901391), Nofima 11/2019, 60 pages, dated 31 March 2019.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Oppdragsgiver: Fiskeri- og havbruksnæringens forskningsfinansiering (FHF)|Oppdragsgivers ref.: FHF 901391

claim_checks.claim: In a 2015 industry survey, more than 60 percent named access to area as the largest problem (cited from Hersoug et al. 2014). Volume in 2016-2017 was lower than in 2015.
claim_checks.extract_quote: I en spørreundersøkelse i 2015 svarte over 60% av respondentene fra næringen at det var det største problemet de sto overfor (Hersoug m.fl. 2014).
claim_checks.note: The extract cites a 2014 report for a 2015 survey. Both dates are kept as stated.

claim_checks.claim: In 2017 Hordaland used 99 percent of approved sites. Other counties left about 10 to 30 percent unused. Monthly use was about 50 to 70 percent. Hordaland density more than 8 times Finnmark.
claim_checks.extract_quote: i 2017 skilte Hordaland seg ut, ved at praktisk talt alle godkjente lokaliteter (99 %) var i bruk i løpet av året
claim_checks.note: Eight-times density and Møre og Romsdal MTB-share ranking are in the same scarcity section.

claim_checks.claim: The three northern counties hold more than 60 percent of coastal-zone sea area, and with Trøndelag more than 75 percent. Nordland has almost twice the coastal-zone area of Finnmark.
claim_checks.extract_quote: De tre nordnorske fylkene har over 60 % av kystsonearealet til Norge, og sammen med Trøndelag blir det over 75 %.
claim_checks.note: Coastal zone is defined as sea surface to 1 nautical mile outside the baseline.

claim_checks.claim: Richardsen et al. (2018) are cited for a little over 33 000 value-chain årsverk in 2016, about 21 percent in aquaculture itself. Property tax about 26 500 kr per approved locality at the 7 per mille maximum.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Det er beregnet at det var litt over 33 tusen årsverk i verdikjeden knyttet til havbruk i 2016 (Richardsen m. fl. 2018).
claim_checks.note: Property-tax figure is cited from Isaksen et al. 2012, not newly measured here.

claim_checks.claim: Havbruksfondet and 2018 capacity sales more than 3.9 billion kroner. State 20 percent, municipalities and counties 80 percent (7/8 to municipalities). About 3 million kroner per locality to municipalities for 2018-2019.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Særlig fra 2018, etter innføring av trafikklyssystemet og Havbruksfondet, og salg til fastpris og på auksjon av kapasitetsøkning, som til sammen ga over 3,9 milliarder kroner i 2018
claim_checks.note: The authors say they cannot conclude who has the strongest incentive.

claim_checks.claim: Few assessed changes give more aquaculture area with certainty or high probability. Three candidates: larger plan areas, auction of pre-screened blocks, and marine industrial parks.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Rapporten identifiserer tre endringer som sannsynligvis kan øke arealtilgangen for havbruk
claim_checks.note: Hovedfunn lists større planområder, auksjon of areal-blokker, and marine industriparker.

claim_checks.claim: Other changes aim at more predictable trade-offs: equal treatment of regional and state interests, and knowledge collected outside plan processes. Requiring inter-municipal plans or binding regional plans is judged politically unlikely in the near term.
claim_checks.extract_quote: så er det lite trolig at dette er et politisk akseptabelt alternativ med det første
claim_checks.note: The quote refers to making regional coastal plans legally binding after the 2019 Municipalities Act.

evidence_direction_note: not_applicable is correct. This is a policy-options paper, not a test of a stated causal effect.
priority_questions_note: A1 (plan area, authority, form), A4 (knowledge collected outside processes), A6 (Havbruksfondet, property tax, jobs). A5 not tagged: county density figures are area-scarcity context. A2 and A3 not tagged: licence and trade-off text is background or method options, not a siting or coexistence study.
